needsAttention.title: Review and merge PR #9
needsAttention.detail: Tests green (281, was 197); simulate-week OK. Touches packages/core, packages/adapters (new), apps/worker, packages/db (migration 0005), scripts/. After merge: apply migration 0005 on the VPS, then docker compose up -d --build (asks first). The worker Dockerfile now copies packages/adapters.

needsAttention.title: First real Instagram post through the adapter needs your OK
needsAttention.detail: The IG adapter mirrors the M1 day-1 probe (container → poll → media_publish, trial fallback on 2207081). It has only run on fixtures. CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 2: say the word in chat before DRY_RUN=false for one approved IG reel.

needsAttention.title: Decide: retry budget, daily caps, stagger
needsAttention.detail: Retry: 4 attempts, 5/15/45 min backoff, 5 min publish deadline (DEFAULT_RETRY_POLICY). Caps: IG 4 / YT 4 / TikTok 4 / Snapchat 1 per local day. Stagger: YouTube next slot, TikTok next day, Snapchat +2 days (DEFAULT_CADENCE; overridable in the settings table key 'cadence').

needsAttention.title: Instagram existence check is a caption match
needsAttention.detail: IG has no idempotency key and research.md documents no lookup by client key, so before a retry the adapter looks for a recent media (±36 h of scheduled_for) with the identical caption. It only ever prevents a resend. Tell me if you'd rather it skip the check and rely on the engine's 'unknown' state alone.

needsAttention.title: No existence check for YouTube or Zernio
needsAttention.detail: YouTube: no documented way to find an upload by our key, so a timed-out upload stays 'unknown' until you look in Studio. Zernio: the Idempotency-Key makes a resend return the original post for 24 h, so a lookup wasn't added; a GET-by-key endpoint isn't in research.md.

needsAttention.title: Add META_APP_ID / META_APP_SECRET to the server env if they aren't there
needsAttention.detail: The daily token-health job needs them (with META_ACCESS_TOKEN) to call debug_token and warn 7 days before the 2027-02-08 data-access lapse. Without them it reports meta=skipped.

CLAUDE.md Commands list (guardrail file): add pnpm simulate-week / pnpm schedule-batch by hand
decisions: Retry status is 'queued' + next_attempt_at (existing enum); 'unknown' and 'failed' never re-enter the queue without a human
A NonRetryableError (bad caption, revoked token, invalid publishAt, Zernio duplicate/spam/cap, assisted platform) fails + alerts at once instead of burning 4 attempts
A row stuck in 'publishing' past the deadline = crashed attempt: recovered via the adapter lookup when it has one, else unknown + alert; never resent
Cap guard holds a post and raises one deduped 'cap-breach' alert instead of rescheduling it
With 4 slots and 4 windows the grid is one slot per window (midpoints); other counts keep the proportional spread of generateCatchUpSlots
Snapchat is never fired (assisted); the scheduler still gives it a +2-day slot under the 1/day cap so the handoff list has a time
simulate-week uses TZ_CREATOR when set, else a labelled fixture zone (Europe/London), and picks a DST-crossing week by construction
Adapters hard-stop at 5 hashtags (IG rule from CLAUDE.md applied to all three) and refuse any body with a location field
An IG container stuck IN_PROGRESS after 5 polls is a retryable rejection (nothing was published; the retry makes a new container)
Trial fallback flag is written to batch_items.trial as fellBack=true (plus flags[]), the keys packages/analytics already reads
blocked: Guard hook blocks any Bash command whose text mentions the overnight playbook file by name (even cat, even inside a heredoc); used the Read/Write tools instead
The session's worker process restarted once and the usage limit paused the run once; both resumed from the last checkpoint with nothing lost
